definitions.explanation: Items that one carries or owns; things that belong to a person.

examples.japanese: {持|も}ち{物|もの}に{名前|なまえ}を{書|か}いてください。
examples.english: Please write your name on your belongings.

examples.japanese: {持|も}ち{物|もの}{検査|けんさ}があります。
examples.english: There will be a belongings inspection.

examples.japanese: {遠足|えんそく}の{持|も}ち{物|もの}リスト
examples.english: List of things to bring for the field trip

notes:
COMPOUND: {持|も}つ (to have, hold) + {物|もの} (thing)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {持|も}ち{物|もの}{検査|けんさ} (belongings check/inspection)
- {持|も}ち{物|もの}リスト (packing list, list of things to bring)
- {貴重|きちょう}{品|ひん}/{大切|たいせつ}な{持|も}ち{物|もの} (valuables)

CONTEXTS:
- School events (field trips, camping)
- Security checkpoints
- Lost and found
- Travel packing
